profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Aptima, Inc.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for UI and server side development on Aptima's Product line and SBIR (Small Business Innovation Research) contracts for the Department of Defense. Extensive UI development using HTML5/JavaScript for Web, Tablet, and Phone deployments. Also develop XAML/WPF based windows applications. These applications are provided data through various data sources which included SQL Server, Web API, WCF/web services, and custom network communication between applications.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for Software Development on the EnergyMeasure™ HOME Application. The software tracks and analyzes every aspect of a home’s energy performance -- from insulation levels to heating and cooling systems and appliances -- and provides customized recommendations for improvements. The underlying design make extensive use of WPF, WCF, and SQL Server based technologies.

positions.title: Senior Computer Scientist
positions.description: Responsible for UI and server side development on SBIR (Small Business Innovation Research) contracts for the Department of Defense and Aptima internal projects.  I developed a wide variety of WPF based applications which make use of data binding, dependency properties, custom control templates, and the MVVM design pattern. These applications where provided data through various data sources which included SQL Server, WCF/web services, and custom network communication between applications. Made extensive use of VS 2008/2010 and Expression Blend to complete these projects

positions.title: Principal Computer Scientist
positions.description: Lead engineer developing a C/C++ based PC anti-piracy technology.  Developed a full 3-tier ASP.net website in C# which allowed developers to protect their titles through this online service.  Developed a PC file watermarking technology.  Researched and developed CD/DVD media authentication method and developed custom ISO/UDF file creator to support this work.  Used skills include: C/C++, C#, ASP .Net, Win32 API, Windows Internals, Window Device Driver/IFS, SQL Server 2005, Cryptology, CVS, Bugzilla, and Sharepoint.

positions.title: Computer Scientist
positions.description: Developer responsible for integrating Adobe postscript and PCL6 into the “IBM Infoprint 21”, a monochrome duplex 21 ppm printer with many paper handling options. Ported code to various embedded platforms. Integrated new page pipeline into core code base.
